To the Milestone Reviewer / Catalyst Reviewer,
Thank you for your valuable feedback. In response to your comments, we have made the following revisions and prepared a new Proof of Achievement (PoA). Please check the updated Notion link below.
Milestone 2 Report Latest Version (December 14, 2024)

https://dear-legend-378.notion.site/Milestone-2-Report-Latest-version-December-14-2024-78b70ff011ca410ea8e955594b3aa601?pvs=4

Key Improvements:
・Explicit Use of the Cardano Logo
・ We have added photos and screenshots demonstrating our compliance with the official Cardano brand guidelines.
・ Note: On the very first page of the photo book, we have included an explanation of Cardano along with an acknowledgment of the support from Catalyst.
・Clear Evidence of NFT Issuance
・ We have provided the transaction URL for the NFT issued on the Cardano blockchain.

Regarding the Philippine Shoot and Future Measures:
The photography in the Philippines was conducted before the requirement to use the Cardano logo on MASU boxes was made explicit. Initially, we received approval for that shoot, but later we were asked to include the Cardano logo on the MASU boxes, which posed a challenge since the shoot had already been completed.
At that time, our plan to demonstrate the connection with Cardano was to mint the photographs as NFTs on the Cardano blockchain and utilize them on the JPEG Store.
However, moving forward with Milestone 3 and subsequent events, we will prepare MASU boxes featuring the Cardano logo from the start, thereby clarifying the brand connection at the time of shooting.
In addition, as we expand to Europe and beyond, we will leverage MASU to engage with users who are new to Cardano. Through NFT photobook distribution and support for wallet setup, we aim to contribute to the broader recognition and adoption of the Cardano ecosystem.
By implementing these improvements, we have taken steps to more clearly demonstrate a direct connection with the Cardano ecosystem.
